displayName: DeepSeek Harness DSH-WRA-R1 whole-repository absorption and runtime realization
priorAbsorption: The prior DSH-EARTR-UC001 closure (2026-08-29, see dsh-eartr-uc001-fresh-chat-return-absorption.json) reconciled only a bounded seven-file external-agent return packet against the same pinned upstream commit, and reached NO_RUNTIME_VALUE_WITH_REASON with zero runtime integration. This DSH-WRA-R1 entry is the first whole-repository (8,953 tracked file) reconciliation of the pinned mirror itself, and the first tranche to implement and prove a runtime-integrated delta (provider-attempt/quota admission composition in the existing Web execute route and rate-limit service).

findings.summary: The existing Web execute route (/api/execute) admitted only one inbound request via limiter.consume() at the top of the handler, then made up to three actual provider calls (one initial plus up to two output-validation retries) via executeAI() with no independent per-attempt admission before each call, even though the rate-limit service already exposed an unused consumeProviderAttempt() primitive for exactly this purpose.
findings.nextAction: Implemented: EXTENSIONS/CVF_v1.6_AGENT_PLATFORM/cvf-web/src/lib/provider-attempt-admission.ts composes consumeProviderAttempt() and is called before the initial executeAI() call and before every retry call in route.ts. A denied admission returns a safe structured 429 response before any provider call, and reconciliation evidence (inboundRequestCount, providerCallCount, retryCount, admittedAttemptCount, deniedAttemptCount) is attached to the governance evidence receipt on every terminal response path.

findings.summary: DSH-001 (event-to-model-context lineage) and DSH-005 (scope-owned reversible lifecycle) were reassessed at execution time against current source per the work order's mandatory reassessment requirement.
findings.nextAction: See the worker return's Overlap And Novelty Classification and External Absorption Value Conversion Matrix sections for the execution-time disposition and evidence for each candidate.
